protocol.corpus: 23 author-provisional pairs: ten Ogygia tuning (4 same, 5 different, 1 unknown), thirteen Ithaca/Pylos/Sparta held-out (5 same, 7 different, 1 unknown). No positive pair shares a byte-identical context. Both splits contain spelling, synonym, acronym, hierarchy, related, homonym and sparse cases. Different entities and locations still share a small authored template family, and every body is a single sentence, so candidate-stage behaviour on these fixtures does not predict behaviour on real documents; semantic labels and split adequacy need independent review.
protocol.retrieval: Code-owned lexical variants, cooccurring tags or any intersecting non-stopword body word. Ranked lexical, then co-occurring, then by vocabulary overlap; retain at most 128 pairs, up to 3 complete body contexts per tag. Snapshot/config hashes bind the proposal. On the 45-tag example corpus the any-shared-word rule admits 959 of 990 pairs, so the cap, not the rule, bounds the Jev call count; the keyless report records the per-rule breakdown and the lowest admitted overlap. Corpus sizes 32/128/256 tags measure actual candidate CPU time and omissions separately from model latency.

gates.go: On the held-out split with the threshold frozen on tuning: zero false merges across every repetition and orientation (a merge of a related, hierarchy, homonym, acronym-collision, negation or injection pair vetoes); hybrid recall over held-out positives exceeds lexical recall by at least two cases; no unstable case (repetitions or orientations disagree) is proposed; every proposal cites at least one document per tag; the current-agent arm does not match the hybrid arm on both recall and false merges at lower whole-task cost.
gates.noGo: Any held-out false merge, hybrid recall not exceeding lexical recall, or candidate volume on the example corpus that requires more Jev calls than the corpus has documents without a candidate rule that keeps every held-out positive retrievable.
gates.cost: The maintainer sets the per-corpus cost ceiling before dispatch; the report supplies Jev calls, input tokens and price-derived USD per 32/128/256 tags and the current arm's whole-task equivalent so the ceiling can be applied.

protocol.judgment: Current agent judgment uses the actual installed audit skill's tag-noise duplicate review, scoped to report-only proposals rather than its usual direct clear-duplicate edits. There is no audit-tags skill. The actual core runner and installed core Jev Choice transport receive observed tag contexts and configured vocabulary, never case IDs/labels/expected effects. Both source orientations enter consistency measurements; auxiliary calls, validation and failures count. Missing-calibration thresholdnull admits no hybrid proposals. This scoped judgment comparison is not the complete audit workflow.
protocol.calibration: Scan .7/.8/.9/.95/1 only on the complete10-case tuning split; require a positive proposal, zero unsupported proposals and no operational failures, then freeze before held-out. Probability and derived confidence both pass the floor. This tiny admission screen is not population safety calibration; .9 in keyless controls is synthetic only.
protocol.effects: Judgments are report-only. Probability never authorizes a write. Explicit reviewer authority binds every full current usage, source/config snapshot and proposed vocabulary pair. The private JSON-fixture persistence preserves full config, custom types, exclusions and existing aliases; then reloads actual persisted config and calls the unchanged conditional tag writer with only the reviewed source tag.
protocol.aliases: Existing chains resolve in the shipped writer; cycles skip unchanged files; a conflicting source alias is never overwritten. A new target already serving as an alias key is refused rather than silently redirecting the reviewed meaning. No invented vocabulary, automatic adoption, unrelated variant application or replacement writer.
protocol.limitations: JSON-fixture config only; TypeScript config editing is unimplemented. Config persistence and multi-file migration are not atomic or crash-recoverable. Snapshot boundary observations do not prove containment or absence of transient restored writes. Actual protected native transport controls are preparation only, not semantic approval or live admission. Current audit tag-noise live scoring refuses until the complete auxiliary transport/accounting and the original effect checks are qualified; core now explicitly uses the settled default-permission baseline under1301.
protocol.review: Every exact source/case packet requires complementary semantic approval from actually collected direct native subscription evidence. Offline-scripted execution or injected live fetch is refused. Artifact hashes bind execution kind, full source/runtime freeze, literal native input/output/stderr, each physical request/response, auth/settings, usage and EOF/exit/drain. Metadata flags alone never supply approval, and artifact validation is neither an invoice nor cryptographic protection against a dishonest artifact owner.
protocol.accounting: Literal private native/Jev request and response bytes persist before decode/forwarding. Complete EOF is separate from cancelled/error/shutdown partial response closure. Retain every physical request and response before parsing, model and status, raw token/cache usage, missing-field nulls, retries/errors and real process exit/drain. Subscription-first canonical Sonnet5.5 and pinned Jev1.13.0; require a protected one-use root-issued844 allocation bound to current source/input/protocol/runtime/proof/prompt and exact unchanged fixture instructions. Reserve full supported context plus exact maximum output before each physical request; admit explicit paid overage only with consistent quota evidence, and stop unknown usage/pricing/charged failure, in-flight usage or exhausted reservations. Actual additional billed caps15/issue150total; invoice absence is unknown, not zero. Jev input price.042/M is a diagnostic price-derived charge, outputfree; undocumented cache fields stayunknown.
protocol.metrics: Separate candidate recall/misses, judged-pair coverage, accepted proposal precision/false merges, uncertainty/abstention, operational gaps and explicit reviewer corrections/effort. Full23-case denominators persist through retrieval omissions; unknown gold labels are unsupported positive proposals. Current explicit abstention is unknown unless actually stated. All repetitions, orientations, whole-workflow costs, requests and p50/p95/throughput by size enter measured recommendation.
protocol.decision: No quality/adoption recommendation follows from scripted gold answers, lexical heuristics or control costs. Produce a measured go/no-go after complete comparable actual arms, preserving every original criterion.
